description: Toybox 10K stages (needs.json new.stages): the phonics island chain, the Toybox library, Fox's workshop, the baby house rooms (kitchen, bathroom, living room, bedroom) the museum hall and the school stage. Each description says where the useful spots are.

phonics_island_chain.description: A calm turquoise sea with a chain of small sandy islands stepping back into the distance in a gentle zigzag, each ringed by light shallow water with a coloured flag (red, yellow, blue, green, front to back) and a signpost; palm islets at the far left and right, sun and clouds. The teaching island is the round sand rug in the foreground (radius 4.6 m round the origin, y 0). Bridge gaps (open water for plank bridges, y 0): gap 1 from the teaching island's back edge (0, -4.6) to island 2's front (-2, -7.7); gap 2 from island 2's back (-2, -11.1) to island 3's front (2, -13.8); gap 3 from (2, -17.4) to island 4 (-2.2, -20.1); gap 4 from (-2.2, -23.9) to island 5 (2.3, -26.6). Island tops (low sand domes, 0.65 m high): island 2 [-2, 0.65, -9.4] (set_isle2, red flag), island 3 [2, 0.65, -15.6] (yellow), island 4 [-2.2, 0.65, -22] (blue), island 5 [2.3, 0.65, -28.6] (green). Open sea for floating things: x -8..-4.8 or 4.8..8 at z -3..-5. Look along the chain from about [0, 4, 9] toward [0, 0, -14] to show the gaps.

toybox_library.description: A cozy Toybox library: soft sage wall, honey wood floor, a round sky-blue reading rug under the teaching area (radius 4.6 m), four tall bookshelves of colourful books (2.4 m tall, at x -7.05, -5, 5 and 7.05, against the wall), a reading corner at the left with a rug, an orange bean bag and a yellow cushion (x -6.5..-4.5, z -4), a wooden counter with a book stamp at the right (top at y 0.9, x 4.5..6.7, z -4.4), a flowering plant and tall curtained windows at the far sides (x ±9.6). Word-wall mural: a blank cream board (set_mural) centred at [0, 2.75, -6.5], 7 m wide and 3 m tall (x -3.5..3.5, y 1.25..4.25), in a wooden frame with a blank header strip above it at y 4.62; put cards on it at z -6.4. Set pieces stay behind z = -3.3.

fox_workshop.description: Fox's wooden workshop: warm plank walls, cork floor with a cream mat under the teaching area, a long workbench along the back with drawers (top at y 0.92, x -5.7..5.7, z -5.85; free bench spots x -5..-1.2 and 1.2..5; jars, a hammer, a brush, paint pots and a tile stack on it), a pegboard of blank coloured word tiles above it (x -4..4, y 1.7..3.8, front at z -6.45; set_tile1..set_tile25), a curtained window at the left (x -8.2), a hanging lamp, a plant, and the word machine (set_machine, a word_machine prop) in the middle back at [0, 0, -3.2], 2.1 m tall: its print slot mouth is at world [0, 0.42, -2.73], gauges set_machine#needle_1/needle_2, lever set_machine#lever. Top-down camera spot over the bench: look down at [-3.2, 0.92, -5.85] from about [-3.2, 3.6, -4.2]. The middle (x -3..3, z -2..3) is clear.

kitchen.description: A soft, bright baby kitchen: butter-yellow wall, soft sage floor, a low white counter with mint doors and a rounded cream top (top at y 0.85, x -5.5..2.3, z -5.95; free counter spots x -5..-4 and -0.5..2.2), a round white sink with a faucet at x -1.2, a fruit bowl at x -3.6, a toy oven (top at y 0.98) at x 3, a sky-blue fridge with a heart and a star magnet at x 4.4, a plant at x 6.4, a window with pink curtains over the sink (y 1.9..3.2), a wall shelf with cups at the left (y 2.1), and a little table with two red chairs at the front left (x -5.8, z -3.6, top at y 0.64, an apple on it). Back wall free for bar models and number lines (z -6.45): x 0.5..6.5 at y 2.5..4.5, and x -3..3 above y 3.5.

bathroom.description: A warm, soft baby bathroom: pale aqua tile wall over a sky-blue tiled wainscot (to y 1.3), soft blue floor, a white bathtub on gold feet at the left ([-4.6, 0, -5.3], 2.1 m long, rim at y 0.96, water surface y 0.69; set_tub, part set_tub#water), a pink bath mat in front of it (z -3.3), a pedestal sink at the right ([3.8, 0, -5.95], basin rim y 1.13) with a mint step stool in front (top y 0.28) and a round mirror above (centre y 2), a pink towel on a gold hook (x 6), a shelf of rolled towels (y 2.3, x -5..-4), a high window in the middle back (y 3.2) and a plant. Clear wall for pictures and words: x -2.5..2.5, y 1.4..2.6 and above y 3.9.

living_room.description: A cozy family living room at baby eye level: warm peach wall, wood floor, a round soft mint rug under the teaching area, a low teal sofa at the middle back (seat top y 0.61, x -2.4..1.2, z -5.7) with a yellow and a rose cushion, three family pictures above it (y 2.3..2.6), a curtained window at the left (x -5.6), a plant, a blue front door at the right ([5.6, 0, -6.45], set_door: turn set_door#door to [0, -90, 0] to open it) with a doormat, a toy box (x 3.4, z -5.6) and a toy basket with a ball and a block (x -3.7, z -4.4).

museum_hall.description: A quiet, tall museum hall: warm cream walls with white pillars (x ±2.6 and ±8.6), high arched windows (x ±5.6, y 3.4..5.6), two gold-framed paintings (x ±5.6, y 2.55), a red carpet with a gold edge leading to a tall great clock at the end (set_clock, grandfather_clock at [0, 0, -6.6], 2.95 m tall; its plain face set_clock_face with hands set_clock_hand_m / set_clock_hand_h shows three o'clock: hide those three and put a working `clock` (size 0.62, parent set_clock, at [0, 1.668, 0.33]) there for time lessons), and four glass display cases on pedestals with a globe [-4.4, 1, -4.6], a crown [4.4, 1, -4.6], a rock [-6.6, 1, -3.6] and a treasure chest [6.6, 1, -3.6] (case tops y 1.85). The middle (x -3..3, z -2..3) is clear.

bedroom.description: A cozy baby bedroom at dusk: soft lavender wall, warm low evening light, a small wooden bed at the left ([-4.6, 0, -5.3], 2.8 m long along x, pillow end at -x, blanket top at y 0.72), a nightstand with a glowing yellow lamp (x -2, top at y 0.75), a window with a crescent moon and stars (x 1.8, y 1.85..3.55), pastel bunting over the bed (y 3.1), a toy box and a red ball at the right (x 5..6.1), a star picture, and a soft cream rug under the teaching area. Slipper spot: the purple mat on the floor in front of the bed, [-4.5, 0, -3.5] (set_rug_bed).

pond_front.description: A pond in the teaching area: the middle of the floor (a 4.6 m circle round x 0, z 0) is glossy pond water on a grass field, with reeds at both edges, a rock and two trees behind. Critters at y 0 sit on the water (ducks swim, a frog sits on a lily_pad prop at y 0.008); put lily pads, splash_ripples and bubbles in the water yourself. Characters who stay dry stand outside the circle (|x| > 4.8 or z > 4.8). For a pond behind the teaching area use the pond preset.

town_street.description: A friendly town street on grey paving: a sand-colored sidewalk with a curb at z -3.6, a back row of six small houses in soft colors (size 2.1, z -6.6) with trees between, a market stall in the middle, street lamps, a bench, a traffic light at the right and a stop sign at the left. The street in front (z > -3.5) is the teaching area. For an empty square use the town preset.

beach_islands.description: A sunny beach on a calm turquoise sea: the teaching area is a round sand beach (radius 4.6 round x 0, z 0), with small palm islands stepping back into the distance, a little sailboat, sun and clouds. The same sea and islands as phonics_island_chain without its flags and signposts, for any seaside lesson.

school_stage.description: A bright school stage for plays and show-and-tell: a raised wooden platform at the back (top at y 0.5, z -6.5..-3.9), red curtains gathered open at both sides (x beyond +-6.6), a red valance with gold trim and swags across the top (y 6.0..7.2), three hanging spotlights with warm lenses, a sky-blue backdrop (x -6.5..6.5, y 0.5..5.9) with stars and bunting. The teaching area in front stays clear and evenly lit (brighter than theatre, which is a dim room for shadow play).

stage_bright.description: Bright warm stage light from above the audience, soft shadows: a school show, not a dim theatre.
